verdict.rationale: Unreal exposes only programmatic control surfaces (Python scripting, Remote Control REST/WebSocket API, C++/Blueprint), none of which constitute natural-language command interfaces; probes confirm no official Epic MCP server and that the most-starred community MCP bridges (chongdashu/unreal-mcp, kvick-games/UnrealMCP) are unmaintained, meaning there is no working path to operate the engine via natural language today.
